tokens.name: surface-950
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface-900
tokens.usage: Raised shells: sidebar, top bar, the chat panel frame.

tokens.name: surface-800
tokens.usage: Cards: match cards, stat tiles, player cards, the table container, the assistant's chat bubble.

tokens.name: surface-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for surface-800 elements; input field fill at rest.

tokens.name: surface-600
tokens.usage: Active table row, selected list item, input field while focused.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between table rows and list items. Decorative only, never a status or focus signal.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Card outlines, input borders at rest, table header underline.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, scores and primary body text on surface-950, surface-900 or surface-800.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and table cell values on surface-950, surface-900 or surface-800.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, timestamps and placeholder text on any surface token, including a focused surface-600 input.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside a disabled control only; never for readable body copy.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, key highlights, the assistant's own accent — a dusk violet, the owl-at-dusk half of the palette.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of a brand fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn on a brand or brand-strong fill.

tokens.name: accent-live
tokens.usage: Live-match indicators, links, the assistant's secondary accent, and every focus ring — a darker, saturated azure blue.

tokens.name: accent-live-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of an accent-live fill.

tokens.name: on-accent-live
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn on an accent-live fill.

tokens.name: data-positive
tokens.usage: Positive deltas, wins, goals for. Always paired with a +/▲ glyph, never colour alone.

tokens.name: data-negative
tokens.usage: Negative deltas, losses, cards and fouls. Always paired with a −/▼ glyph, never colour alone.

tokens.name: data-neutral
tokens.usage: Draws and zero-change deltas.

tokens.name: chat-user-surface
tokens.usage: The visitor's own chat bubble fill, set apart from the assistant's reply.

tokens.name: chat-ai-surface
tokens.usage: The assistant's reply bubble fill — the same tone as a card, so its answers read as data, not chrome.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px outline on every interactive element, offset 2px from the control, in every state.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a modal or the mobile navigation drawer.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: A hero scoreline, or the single biggest number on a page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page hero title — a match or team page's H1.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: A component's own title, e.g. a card header.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Table section title, sidebar group label.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Chat message text and other long-form answers.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Button label, nav item, form label.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase caption: tag text, table column header, timestamp prefix.

styles.name: data-xl
styles.usage: The scoreboard score on a match card.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: A stat tile's value — xG, possession, passes completed.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: A numeric table cell, set with tabular figures.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Match clock, jersey number, inline timestamp.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a stat tile's label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside a chip or badge; gap between table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding; gap between stacked form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a card and its container edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing; padding inside a chat bubble.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The sidebar's internal top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top spacing above a page hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, table row hover fill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: match card, stat tile, player card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The chat composer and modal dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, team badges, pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting lift for a card off surface-900.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown menus, the chat composer's suggestion list.
